title: Broken access control: any member can self-assign arbitrary BuddyPress member types via the ungated "types" REST parameter, bypassing the bp_moderate
vulnerabilityInformation: A vulnerability was identified in BuddyPress 14.5.0's Members REST endpoint. The permission check only validated the "member_type" parameter, while a legacy "types" alias was processed afterward without authorization checks. This allowed any authenticated low-privilege user to assign arbitrary member types to their own profile, bypassing the bp_moderate capability requirement.
